description.value: Ocean Park Community Orchard is a small, resident-initiated orchard established in 2016 on the northern lot of Ocean Park Terrace park in South Surrey. The surrounding green space features large open fields suitable for a rest or picnic stop. The site is publicly accessible and managed by the City of Surrey.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The City of Surrey parks page confirms this is a publicly accessible community orchard and green space at 12814 - 22 Avenue, Surrey BC, established in 2016. The website provides contact info (phone 604-501-5050) and a physical address, but mentions no cyclist-specific amenities such as bike parking, washrooms, or water. OSM tags confirm public access (access=yes) but carry no amenity detail.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only so contact_confirmed cannot be verified against OSM.
No cyclist amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) confirmed from website or OSM tags — all required criteria are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a small public community orchard with no confirmed cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water). It may be a pleasant incidental stop but lacks evidence of the infrastructure typically expected for a WWC directory listing.

wow_evidence: Small resident-run orchard in a park — pleasant ordinary.
blurb: Small community orchard in Ocean Park Terrace park.

price.signal: Municipal park with dawn-to-dusk access, no admission fee mentioned
